channel.title: AI News Radar - Frontier AI Intel, Social Signals & Tools
channel.description: Real-time panoramic intelligence radar for global frontier AI breakthroughs, verified leader signals, hands-on tutorials, and applied developer tools.

item.title: Sources: hackers breached the US Department of Agriculture's system that facilitates payments to farmers this week (Julia Ainsley/NBC News)
item.description: The U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) suffered a cyberattack this week, impacting the core system responsible for processing payments to farmers. This breach raises significant concerns regarding the compromise of sensitive data and the vulnerability of critical federal infrastructure to sophisticated cyber threats.

item.title: Artificial Analysis says Inkling 2 Mini, with 5.4B active parameters, matches Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh) on its Intelligence Index with ~5x fewer active parameters (Artificial Analysis)
item.description: Thinking Machines has released the open-weights Inkling 2 Mini model, utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture with 26B total and 5.4B active parameters. By employing looped Transformer layers, the model achieves performance parity with Qwen3.8 27B while utilizing only 20% of the active parameters, all under an Apache 2.0 license.

item.title: Cognition in Talks for $75 Billion Value With New Funding
item.description: AI startup Cognition AI is in advanced funding talks to raise over $2 billion, aiming for a $75 billion valuation. The company specializes in autonomous software-engineering agents capable of planning, coding, testing, and deploying software with minimal human intervention, marking a rapid valuation surge from $26 billion in May.

item.title: Many Etsy Sellers Close Up Shop Over Site’s New A.I. Policy
item.description: Etsy has introduced new terms of service, effective December 16, allowing the company and its third-party partners to use seller content for training and testing AI models. This prompted widespread backlash and shop closures from creators, despite claims from James Ossman, VP of customer operations, that data use is restricted to fraud detection and advertising, as users remain concerned about the lack of opt-out mechanisms and potential IP exploitation.

item.title: Canada Retail Sales Tracking Largest Decline Since Feb. 2025
item.description: Canadian retail sales are projected to decline by 1.5% in October, marking the sharpest drop since February 2025. Despite resilient growth in the third quarter, the combination of escalated trade disputes and a stagnant labor market has dampened fourth-quarter momentum, prompting analysts to expect a pause in rate hikes by the Bank of Canada.

item.title: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)
item.description: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights model with 26.4B parameters, utilizing a 'looped transformer' architecture that executes middle layers three times per token. This design enhances reasoning capabilities for agentic coding and serial tasks while maintaining a 20GB memory footprint suitable for local deployment on consumer hardware.

item.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
item.description: HD Moore, Chief Research Officer at Dragos, uncovered major security flaws in the AI supply chain by injecting 2 million trackable 'canary' secrets into AI prompts sent via routing services. The investigation found evidence of prompt theft, disregard for zero-data-retention (ZDR) settings, and unauthorized logging of user prompts by intermediaries, posing significant compliance risks.

item.title: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
item.description: OpenAI has deployed layered security mechanisms for GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol models, reducing the success rate of black-box inference-extraction attacks from 54% to under 0.2% through targeted training, input/output filtering, and API access restrictions. These measures are designed to neutralize distillation attacks that attempt to reconstruct core reasoning paths, supplemented by the weekly suspension of tens of thousands of illicit accounts.

item.title: Bloomberg Europe
item.description: Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Vodafone, and Telefónica are in early talks to form a consortium to bid for the EU's 2 GHz satellite spectrum. The initiative aims to secure a European-controlled operator status for the reserved band, effectively creating a strategic counterweight to SpaceX's Starlink in the consumer direct-to-device satellite market.

item.title: Nvidia's accounting is a focus of US SEC investigation, sources say
item.description: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has launched an investigation into Nvidia's accounting practices. Enforcement staff are scrutinizing potential irregularities, a probe that compounds the company's existing challenges, including the leadership scandal and ongoing investigations into illicit chip shipments to China via regional partners.

item.title: Nvidia stock plunges 12%, rides longest weekly losing streak since 2008 financial crisis
item.description: Nvidia is facing severe capital market volatility following the resignation of co-founder Jensen Huang due to conduct violations, compounded by an SEC inquiry into its accounting practices. Despite interim CEO Colette Kress maintaining optimistic fiscal projections, investors are increasingly concerned about the company's long-term AI leadership and competitive erosion from AMD and Google.

item.title: KKR in Talks to Buy EdgeCore at Valuation of at Least $8 Billion
item.description: Private equity firm KKR is in advanced negotiations to acquire data center operator EdgeCore Digital Infrastructure from Partners Group, with a valuation between $8 billion and $10 billion. The acquisition, executed through KKR's Helix platform, aims to consolidate EdgeCore's 2.27+ gigawatts of capacity across key U.S. markets to meet the insatiable demand for AI infrastructure.

item.title: Take-Two says GTA VI generated $3.79B in day-one sales, surpassing the $2.9B lifetime box-office gross of the highest-grossing film Avengers: Endgame (Jennifer Maas/Variety)
item.description: Take-Two Interactive’s 'Grand Theft Auto VI', developed by Rockstar Games, generated $3.79 billion in sales on its launch day, surpassing the lifetime global box-office gross of 'Avengers: Endgame' and setting a new record for the entertainment industry. The title, released on PS5 and Xbox, priced at $80-$100, achieved a Metacritic score of 99, cementing its dominant position in interactive entertainment.

item.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
item.description: Nvidia's board of directors ousted CEO Jensen Huang after an investigation confirmed he misled the board for a year regarding his relationship with an employee at Singapore-based Megaspeed and potential national security implications. While external reports focused on foreign intelligence ties, Board Chair Harvey Jones cited a fundamental lack of integrity and violation of corporate governance policies as the primary drivers for the termination.

item.title: Signal blocks screenshots on iOS 27 and Android to stop AI agents from reading private chats
item.description: Signal has implemented screenshot blocking on iOS 27 and specific Android versions to counter OS-level AI agents like Siri, Gemini, and Meta's Muse, which can scrape screen contents. Signal warns that these AI agents, often leveraging system-level permissions or accessibility tools, undermine end-to-end encryption by extracting decrypted messages directly from the display interface.

item.title: Canada Retail Sales Tracking Largest Decline Since Feb. 2025
item.description: Statistics Canada reports an estimated 1.5% decline in retail sales for October, marking the sharpest drop since February 2025. CIBC senior economist Andrew Grantham noted that the decline reflects broader volume contraction and stagnant labor market growth, signaling weakening economic momentum heading into the final quarter of 2026.

item.title: Google's Gemini can now run Mac apps and finish desktop chores in the background while you keep working
item.description: Google has integrated the 'Computer Use' feature into its Gemini Mac app, allowing the AI to simulate mouse clicks, keyboard inputs, and menu navigation within isolated background windows. This enables the autonomous execution of multi-step tasks across local files and web applications while allowing users to maintain foreground workflow continuity.

item.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed a 'tremendous tax' on American companies that construct AI data centers outside the country. This policy initiative is framed as a matter of national security, aiming to prevent the offshore migration of critical computing infrastructure and ensure the sovereignty of the domestic AI supply chain.

item.title: YouTube Finalizing Multibillion-Dollar Settlement With Schools Over Social Media Addiction Claims
item.description: YouTube, a subsidiary of Alphabet, is finalizing an agreement-in-principle with various U.S. school districts to settle litigation regarding the addictive nature of its platform features. The proposed settlement is valued at approximately $3 billion, with final execution expected to take several months.

item.title: Trump says he would block US companies from building data centers overseas or impose a "tremendous tax" on them if they do (Julianna Bragg/Axios)
item.description: Former President Donald Trump proposed a policy aimed at anchoring AI infrastructure within the U.S., threatening to block American companies from constructing data centers abroad or imposing heavy taxes if they do so. This policy stance follows heightened voter concern over the environmental and financial impacts of domestic data center expansion, though the legal mechanism for implementing such taxes remains unclear given Congressional oversight.

item.title: Spying Suspect’s Chip Network Has Ties to Chinese Military Suppliers
item.description: Intelligence firm Strider Technologies identified that Alice Huang and her associates built a complex network utilizing $3.6 billion in Chinese government funding for data centers equipped with Nvidia AI chips. The investigation reveals that these entities maintain deep ties to Chinese military contractors and the Ministry of State Security, posing significant compliance risks regarding the diversion of restricted hardware into military research.

item.title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update
item.description: Nonprofit evaluation group METR has updated its time-horizon plot for AI capabilities, indicating that models show exponential growth in verifiable tasks like coding and mathematics, but lag in judgment-based tasks that lack automated verification. The report highlights the technological bottleneck in applying reinforcement learning to complex, open-ended research decisions, a capability critical for future autonomous R&D.

item.title: Top Republican Senator Says Lutnick Ignored His China Chip Warnings
item.description: Senator Tom Cotton, Chair of the Senate Intelligence Committee, accused Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick of repeatedly ignoring warnings regarding the smuggling of AI chips to China. This criticism, following the Nvidia scandal, highlights growing congressional dissatisfaction with the Department of Commerce's regulatory oversight and enforcement efficacy.

item.title: Trump, Xi agreed humans must stay in charge of AI military decisions, Bessent says
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping agreed during their meeting at the APEC summit in Shenzhen that humans must maintain control over military decisions involving artificial intelligence, prohibiting autonomous 'superintelligence' (SI) in major military actions, as confirmed by U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. The leaders also engaged in robust discussions regarding nuclear non-proliferation, trade policy, and the Russia-Ukraine conflict, culminating in a joint declaration emphasizing that nuclear war must never be fought.

item.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
item.description: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics’s most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world’s best mathematicians for decades. If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval already unleashed by OpenAI’s previous, often inelegant forays into the field. item.title: Linq, which offers texting and calling infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $90M Series B led by a16z, following a $20M Series A in February (Harper Harwell/Birmingham Business Journal)
item.description: Linq, a provider of specialized communication infrastructure for AI agents, has secured $90 million in Series B funding led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). This financing follows a $20 million Series A round in February, underscoring rapid capital deployment into the foundational connectivity layer of the AI agent ecosystem.

item.title: Bloomberg analysis of 10 million job postings shows AI-exposed roles in China fell 10 percentage points faster than others
item.description: of nearly 10 million job postings reveals that AI is significantly disrupting China's labor market, disproportionately affecting entry-level and creative roles. Vulnerable positions have seen a demand decline 10 percentage points sharper than non-impacted roles, with research from ShanghaiTech University and the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences confirming structural shifts including role consolidation and quiet staff reductions at major internet firms.

item.title: Anthropic Share Slump Nearly Erases IPO Pop As AI Trade Unravels
item.description: Anthropic PBC shares erased much of their first-day jump on Friday, testing investors' faith after the AI lab delivered the biggest initial public offering in history.
